title: Free public AI-readable website discovery
question: Can public discovery improve without granting private access or buying services?
hypotheses: Static Markdown and explicit content preferences preserve existing public client behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Free only: search and AI-input allowed, AI-training disallowed as content preferences.
Public discovery follows gateway latest pointers and immutable payloads with current Web destinations.
Static Markdown and sitemap verified; no private access or normal-client changes.
Test, review and verify actual website publication separately from source merge.
evidence: Owner explicitly confirmed recommended content policy and free-only boundary.
